top_signals.title: Russia’s Novorossiysk Resumed Crude Loadings After Days of Halt
top_signals.summary: The largest Russian oil port in the Black Sea resumed crude loadings after several days of disruption, during a period of bad weather and increased drone attacks in the nearby area.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: AT&T Cuts Through Europe’s Summer Lull With Five-Part Bond Deal
top_signals.summary: AT&T Inc. is raising at least €2 billion ($2.23 billion) of bonds, shattering a traditionally subdued period for Europe’s primary market with a large corporate deal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Why Trump's new tariff blitz is very different this time around
top_signals.summary: President Trump on Friday launched a fresh round of tariffs targeting 60 trading partners, including the European Union, China, and the U.K.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
